name: Hill Forts of Rajasthan
description: Six great Rajput strongholds across Rajasthan make up this group: Chittorgarh, Kumbhalgarh, Ranthambore, Gagron, Amer and Jaisalmer. Built on hills, desert ridges and river bluffs, some have walls stretching up to 20 kilometres. Inside you can wander palaces, temples and old town quarters, plus reservoirs and water-harvesting systems that are still used today.
